Eras (intervals) built from an event

Source: R/lang_v2.R
omop_era.Rd

Recorded closed intervals are normalised by the era's own end and fallback from the event's original recorded end and supply roles, then coalesced per person and group: a new era starts when a record starts more than gap unobserved days after the running maximum end. by = "ingredient" groups drug concepts by their RxNorm ingredient (unmapped concepts follow unmapped); persistence extends courses only; stockpile = TRUE adds an effective-supply relation selected explicitly by covered_days(coverage = "effective_supply").

Usage

omop_era(
  event,
  gap = 30L,
  persistence = 0L,
  min_days = 0L,
  by = c("event", "concept", "ingredient"),
  unmapped = c("own_concept", "drop"),
  end = c("recorded_end", "start"),
  fallback = c("days_supply", "none"),
  stockpile = FALSE,
  name = NULL
)

Arguments

event

An omop_event (or its name).

gap

Tolerated uncovered days between records.

persistence

Days added to each course end.

min_days

Minimum course length.

by

"event", "concept" or "ingredient".

unmapped

"own_concept" or "drop" (ingredient grouping).

end

"recorded_end" or "start" (point records).

fallback

"days_supply" or "none".

stockpile

Logical.

name

Interval name.

Value

An omop_interval object.
